status: Development horizon extension. The frozen one-month primary remains unchanged.
target: Cumulative adjusted-close asset return from the first trading-day close after the decision cutoff through the first trading-day close after the Hth future month-end.
forecast_dates: Monthly decision dates with a completed target available for training. A target may enter training only after its exit date. All input processing, policy eligibility checks and alpha tuning remain fold-local and inherit corrected-primary-v1.
overlap: Three- and six-month targets are allowed to overlap for the forecast-accuracy sample because each monthly decision is a separate prediction. Error summaries describe dependence and do not treat overlapping targets as independent observations.
portfolio: For portfolio results, use the first eligible forecast and then the next forecast whose entry is after the prior H-month exit. Each position is held for the full H-month target interval; there are no overlapping holdings. Covariance uses the latest 36 completed H-month return observations with at least 12 required. Black–Litterman uses the same tau, risk aversion, bounds, grid and 5 bp cost rule, with all quantities expressed in H-month return units.
evaluation: Report per-asset MAE, RMSE and OOS R2 against the expanding historical mean for all eligible monthly forecast dates, plus largest forecast and 20% warning counts. Report non-overlapping portfolio return, daily drawdown, turnover and costs as descriptive secondary results. No reserved-period outcome is used.
limitations: The sample is short for six-month non-overlapping portfolio results. Revised macro histories and assumed availability lags remain. A rolling 12-month evaluation window is a diagnostic evaluation sample, not a 12-month forecast target.
